## Checklist

- [ ] One topic only: this pull request covers a single change.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (for example `feat(scenarios): ...`).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (DCO): `git commit -s`.
- [ ] Tests and lint pass locally (`npm run format:check`, `npm run check`, `npm test`).
- [ ] UI changes include before and after screenshots (fictitious data only).
- [ ] No secrets, and no real hostnames, IP addresses or target data.
